dialogue.origin: こんにちは！急な承認ありがとうございます！今日はよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Hello! Thank you for approving on such short notice. I look forward to our session today.

dialogue.origin: 入りました。こんにちは。
dialogue.content: I've joined. Hello.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、ギリギリで失礼いたしました。
dialogue.content: Likewise, I'm sorry for the last-minute notice on my end.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは！急な承認ありがとうございます！今日はよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Hello! Thank you for approving on such short notice. I look forward to our session today.

dialogue.origin: 間違い2個送ってしまいました
dialogue.content: Oops, I accidentally sent that twice.

dialogue.origin: 時間は今からでも大丈夫ですし、10時からでも良いですよ！
dialogue.content: I'm fine to start now, or we can begin at 10 o'clock—whichever works for you.

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫です。始めましょうか。
dialogue.content: That's fine. Shall we begin?

dialogue.origin: 承知しました！ではよろしくお願い致します
dialogue.content: Understood! Let's get started then.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。相談員です。
dialogue.content: Hello. I'm the counselor.

dialogue.origin: 今日はどうされたのですか？
dialogue.content: What brings you here today?

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。彼とのことで・・
dialogue.content: Hello. It's about my boyfriend...

dialogue.origin: 彼さんのことでお悩みなのですね。。
dialogue.content: I see, you're having some trouble regarding your boyfriend.

dialogue.origin: よければ詳しく教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: If you're comfortable, could you tell me more about it?

dialogue.origin: はい、先日、彼の携帯をのぞいてしまったんです。
dialogue.content: Yes, the other day, I ended up looking through his phone.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それで、、、
dialogue.content: I see. And then...

dialogue.origin: 半年も前から、浮気してたみたいで、
dialogue.content: It seems he's been cheating on me for about six months.

dialogue.origin: ええ！そうなんですね……
dialogue.content: Oh my... I see...

dialogue.origin: 最近忙しがってるし、様子も変だな、って思って、覗いちゃったんです
dialogue.content: He's been saying he's busy lately and acting strange, so I couldn't help but look.

dialogue.origin: 思い当たる節があって、実行されたのですね…
dialogue.content: So you had a feeling something was wrong, and that's why you did it...

dialogue.origin: そしたら、一緒に旅行にも行ってたみたいだし、・・・ショックです
dialogue.content: And then I found out they'd even gone on a trip together... I'm in shock.

dialogue.origin: 携帯をのぞくのはとても恐ろしかったでしょうね……
dialogue.content: It must have been very frightening to look through his phone...

dialogue.origin: えええ！
dialogue.content: Oh my goodness!

dialogue.origin: 私にうそをついてまで…ひどいです
dialogue.content: He even lied to me... It's awful.

dialogue.origin: 旅行まで……
dialogue.content: Even a trip...

dialogue.origin: それはひどいですね……さぞ、おつらい気持ちでしょうね……
dialogue.content: That is terrible. You must be feeling so hurt.

dialogue.origin: ショックで、どうしたらいいか、分かりません
dialogue.content: I'm so shocked I don't know what to do.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね……いま、衝撃すぎてどうしていいか、分からないと思います……
dialogue.content: I understand... I imagine you're in too much shock right now to know what to do...
Yes...

dialogue.origin: ゆっくり、一緒に考えていきましょう。
dialogue.content: Let's take our time and think this through together.

dialogue.origin: 信じられません…
dialogue.content: I can't believe it...

dialogue.origin: あなたのこと、なんてお呼びしたらよろしいですか？よければ年齢も。
dialogue.content: How would you like me to address you? And your age, if you don't mind.

dialogue.origin: 20歳、ゆき、です。
dialogue.content: I'm Yuki, 20 years old.

dialogue.origin: ゆきさん、ありがとうございます。ほんとうに、ショックだと思いますが、昨晩眠れましたか？
dialogue.content: Thank you, Yuki. I know this must be a huge shock, but were you able to sleep last night?

dialogue.origin: ショックで眠れませんでした。
dialogue.content: I was too shocked to sleep.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね…ゆきさんのお身体と、心が心配です。
dialogue.content: I can imagine... I'm worried about your physical and mental well-being, Yuki.

dialogue.origin: 彼との交際期間はどのくらいですか？
dialogue.content: How long have you been dating him?

dialogue.origin: 2年くらいです
dialogue.content: About two years.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。。おかしいな？と思ったのがいつごろですか？
dialogue.content: I see. When did you start feeling that something was off?

dialogue.origin: 半年前くらいから、です
dialogue.content: About six months ago.

dialogue.origin: そんなに前から……不安な毎日を過ごされたのでしょうね、ゆきさん……
dialogue.content: For that long... You must have spent every day feeling anxious, Yuki...

dialogue.origin: 覗きたくなかったけど、覗いてしましました
dialogue.content: I didn't want to look, but I ended up doing it.

dialogue.origin: えぇ。。お気持ちが痛いほどわかります……
dialogue.content: Yes... I can only imagine how painful that must have been...

dialogue.origin: こんなこと、分かったら、きっとは慣れて行っちゃうよね…
dialogue.content: If he finds out about this, he'll probably leave me...

dialogue.origin: 離れて”
dialogue.content: *leave me

dialogue.origin: と、いうことは、まだ彼さんにはそのことについて、伝えていないようですね
dialogue.content: So, it seems you haven't told him about this yet.

dialogue.origin: です、間違いました
dialogue.content: Yes—sorry, I mistyped.

dialogue.origin: (大丈夫ですよ)
dialogue.content: (It's okay.)

dialogue.origin: はい、とても言えません
dialogue.content: Yes, I can't possibly tell him.

dialogue.origin: 言えない…それは、自分の元から離れていってしまう、
dialogue.content: You can't say it... Is that because you're afraid he'll leave you?

dialogue.origin: という不安から？？
dialogue.content: Is that the fear?

dialogue.origin: うん。だって、彼はすごい人気者だし、交際範囲も広いし、それに、
dialogue.content: Yes. Because he's really popular, has a wide social circle, and besides,

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: こんなことする子なんて、彼にふさわしくないよね、、、
dialogue.content: A girl who does something like this isn't worthy of him, right...

dialogue.origin: ゆきさんは、そんな彼のこと、とっても好きなんですね
dialogue.content: Yuki, you must really love him a lot.

dialogue.origin: はい、好きだけど、不安もたくさんあります
dialogue.content: Yes, I love him, but I have a lot of anxieties too.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、人気者の彼を持つと不安ですね
dialogue.content: I see, having a popular boyfriend can make you feel insecure.

dialogue.origin: そう、人気者だから、いつも不安だった。
dialogue.content: Yes, because he's so popular, I was always anxious.

dialogue.origin: いつも、不安……そんな2年間だったのですね……
dialogue.content: Always anxious... So that's how the two years have been...

dialogue.origin: 長くつらい2年間……
dialogue.content: Two long, painful years...

dialogue.origin: 本当は覗きたくはなかったけど、
dialogue.content: I really didn't want to look, but...

dialogue.origin: 覗かずにはいられなかったんです。
dialogue.content: I couldn't stop myself from looking.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。。
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm..

dialogue.origin: 不安なゆきさんの気持ちが、耐えられなくなったのですね
dialogue.content: Your anxious feelings became too much to bear, didn't they, Yuki?

dialogue.origin: もう、無理ですよね？
dialogue.content: It's hopeless, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: ゆきさんは、どうしたいの？
dialogue.content: What do you want to do, Yuki?
Hmm...

dialogue.origin: (まってるよ)
dialogue.content: (I'll wait.)

dialogue.origin: 好きだけど…
dialogue.content: I love him, but...

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: I hear you.

dialogue.origin: 嫌われたら怖い、
dialogue.content: I'm scared he'll hate me.

dialogue.origin: 嫌われたくないんだね
dialogue.content: You don't want him to hate you.

dialogue.origin: そうか。。
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 彼の、他にどんなところが、ゆきさん好きなのかな？
dialogue.content: What other things do you like about him, Yuki?

dialogue.origin: いつもゆきのことを、褒めてくれるし、励ましてくれる
dialogue.content: He always praises me and encourages me.

dialogue.origin: そっか！
dialogue.content: I see!

dialogue.origin: どんなところを？
dialogue.content: What kinds of things does he praise you for?

dialogue.origin: 自分では、気づいていない小さなことでも見つけてくれて、
dialogue.content: He notices even the little things that I don't notice about myself,

dialogue.origin: そか。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: それでそれで？
dialogue.content: And what else?

dialogue.origin: やる気を上げてくれたり、はじめの頃は、
dialogue.content: He would motivate me, and in the beginning,

dialogue.origin: はじめのころ！！は？？？
dialogue.content: In the beginning! And now?

dialogue.origin: いまは？
dialogue.content: And now?

dialogue.origin: とってもまめにラインとかくれて、いろんなとこに連れてってくれた…
dialogue.content: He used to text me very frequently and take me all sorts of places...

dialogue.origin: そっかそっか
dialogue.content: I see, I see.

dialogue.origin: で、いまは？？
dialogue.content: And now??

dialogue.origin: 最近は、忙しがってたから、少し待つことが増えてきました
dialogue.content: Lately, he's been saying he's busy, so I've found myself waiting for him more often.

dialogue.origin: そうなのね。。
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 忙しくて会えなくても、
dialogue.content: Even if he's too busy to see you,

dialogue.origin: ゆきさんのこと思いやってさみしくさせないように、
dialogue.content: is he considerate of your feelings, trying not to make you feel lonely,

dialogue.origin: 努力してくれてるのかな？
dialogue.content: is he making an effort?

dialogue.origin: (まってるね)
dialogue.content: (I'll wait.)

dialogue.origin: それが、前はすごく頻繁だったから、幸せだったけど、最近減ったのは、不安だったけど、むしろその方が普通なのかと思ってみたりもしました。
dialogue.content: Well, it used to be so frequent, which made me happy. I was anxious that it has decreased recently, but I also tried to think that maybe this is more normal.

dialogue.origin: そっかそっか。。
dialogue.content: I see, I see...

dialogue.origin: かれもいろいろあるし、邪魔もしたくなかったから。
dialogue.content: He has his own things going on, and I didn't want to be a bother.

dialogue.origin: 優しいね、ゆきさん。彼のこと、思いやって我慢して、ほんとに優しいね！
dialogue.content: That's so kind of you, Yuki. You're being considerate of him and patient. You're truly a kind person!

dialogue.origin: でも、覗くなんて、サイテーだよね…
dialogue.content: But snooping... that's the worst, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: うぅん、サイテーじゃないよ、ぜんぜん。
dialogue.content: No, it's not the worst. Not at all.

dialogue.origin: のぞくの怖かったよね
dialogue.content: It was scary to look, wasn't it?

dialogue.origin: でも、それを乗り越えてのぞいてみたんだよね
dialogue.content: But you overcame that fear and looked anyway.

dialogue.origin: うん、でも、覗いたら、もっと怖いことになった
dialogue.content: Yeah, but when I looked, things got even scarier.

dialogue.origin: うん、うん、、そうだね。もっと怖いことが書いてあったね……
dialogue.content: Yes, yes... that's true. You found something even more frightening...

dialogue.origin: 少し、お話をまとめますね
dialogue.content: Let me summarize our conversation a bit.

dialogue.origin: ゆきさんの人気者な彼、最初は優しくてゆきさんのこと楽しませてくれたけど、
dialogue.content: Your popular boyfriend was kind and made you happy at first,

dialogue.origin: 最近は忙しくてゆきさんを寂しい思いにさせている。
dialogue.content: but lately he's been busy and making you feel lonely.

dialogue.origin: ゆきさん、怖いけどがんばって彼に嫌われないようにそんな彼を責めたりしなかった
dialogue.content: Yuki, even though you were scared, you tried your best not to blame him so that he wouldn't dislike you.

dialogue.origin: そんな優しいゆきさん。。けど、
dialogue.content: You're so kind, Yuki... but,

dialogue.origin: 思いやりがあるのは、ゆきさんだけだね。
dialogue.content: it seems you're the only one being considerate.

dialogue.origin: 彼はゆきさんを寂しくさせないような、思いやりは感じられない……
dialogue.content: He doesn't seem to be showing the consideration needed to keep you from feeling lonely...

dialogue.origin: ここまでどうかな？ちがうところがあるかな？
dialogue.content: How does that sound so far? Does any of that feel wrong to you?

dialogue.origin: そうだよね、やっぱり彼は、私に思いやりなんてなかったのかな…
dialogue.content: You're right. I guess he really didn't have any consideration for me...

dialogue.origin: ちなみに、浮気していたってところが抜けました。わたしは、浮気の有無は関係ないと思いました。
dialogue.content: By the way, I left out the part about him cheating. I felt that whether or not he cheated isn't the core issue here.

dialogue.origin: 関係ないですか？
dialogue.content: It's not relevant?

dialogue.origin: それ以前に、ゆきさんを寂しくさせない、思いやりがない、そこが彼には問題があるとおもいました。
dialogue.content: Before even getting to that, the fact that he isn't considerate enough to keep you from feeling lonely—I think that's the real problem.

dialogue.origin: どうかな？
dialogue.content: What do you think?

dialogue.origin: でも、たくさんのお友達にもきっと思いやりを配ってるんじゃないかって思う…
dialogue.content: But I think he's probably very considerate to all of his many friends...

dialogue.origin: そういうところが、好き。
dialogue.content: That's what I like about him.

dialogue.origin: そうだね。彼は誰にでも優しいからね。
dialogue.content: That's true. He is kind to everyone.

dialogue.origin: ゆきさんは、自分のこと好き？
dialogue.content: Yuki, do you like yourself?

dialogue.origin: 彼と一緒にいるときの自分は好きだけど、今の自分は、、、
dialogue.content: I like who I am when I'm with him, but the person I am now...

dialogue.origin: ダメだなって、思う。
dialogue.content: I feel like I'm no good.

dialogue.origin: 今の自分は？
dialogue.content: The you right now?

dialogue.origin: なんでそう思うのかな？
dialogue.content: Why do you think that?

dialogue.origin: 自分に負けて、覗いっちゃったこと、ダメって思うし、
dialogue.content: I feel bad because I gave in and looked,

dialogue.origin: うん、うん、、
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm...

dialogue.origin: 信じようとしてたはずなのに、結局、信じてなかったのかもとも思う。
dialogue.content: I thought I was trying to trust him, but in the end, I guess I really didn't.

dialogue.origin: これからどうしようかと思うと、物凄く不安。
dialogue.content: When I think about what to do from here on out, I feel extremely anxious.

dialogue.origin: そっかそっか。信じてあげられなかったことが、自分ダメだっておもっちゃったんだね。。
dialogue.content: I see, I see. So you feel like you're a bad person because you couldn't bring yourself to trust him.

dialogue.origin: いま、彼がいなくなったら、どうなると思う？
dialogue.content: What do you think would happen if he were gone now?

dialogue.origin: ゆきだけが一人、ひとりぼっち、皆の輪にもいられない
dialogue.content: I'd be all alone, by myself, unable to be part of everyone's social circle.

dialogue.origin: 彼とお別れしてしまったら、お友達もいなくなってしまうってこと？
dialogue.content: So you feel that if you were to break up with him, you'd lose your friends too?

dialogue.origin: 人気者だから、共通の仲間もたくさんいるし、居場所がない気がして、つらい…
dialogue.content: Because he's so popular, we have a lot of mutual friends, and I feel like I wouldn't have a place to belong, which is painful...

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね。。そんな不安があるのね。。
dialogue.content: I see... So you have that anxiety...

dialogue.origin: でも、ゆきさんは、ひとりじゃないよ！！
dialogue.content: But, Yuki, you are not alone!!

dialogue.origin: ゆきさんは彼や友達を大切にしているように、同じくらい大切にされないといけないんだよ
dialogue.content: Just as you cherish your boyfriend and your friends, you deserve to be cherished just as much.

dialogue.origin: その価値がゆきさんにはあるの
dialogue.content: You are worthy of that.

dialogue.origin: どうかな？
dialogue.content: How does that feel?

dialogue.origin: そうかな。ゆきに価値が？
dialogue.content: Do you think so? I have worth?

dialogue.origin: そうだよ！！ゆきさんばかり頑張ってないといけない関係って違うと思うの。
dialogue.content: Yes, you do!! I think a relationship where you're the only one who has to try so hard is wrong.

dialogue.origin: だって疲れちゃうでしょ？
dialogue.content: Because that's exhausting, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: うん、そうかもしれないけど、好きな気持ちが・・・
dialogue.content: Yeah, maybe so, but my feelings of love for him...

dialogue.origin: 浮気されてまでも、好き、なんて、情けないね…
dialogue.content: It's pathetic, isn't it... to still love him even after he cheated on me.

dialogue.origin: 情けなくないよ！だってね、
dialogue.content: It's not pathetic! Because, you see,

dialogue.origin: 不安な時って、身動きがとれないものなのね、
dialogue.content: When you're anxious, it's natural to feel paralyzed,

dialogue.origin: でも、すごく怖い思いをして携帯を覗いた
dialogue.content: but you faced that incredible fear and looked at his phone.

dialogue.origin: 行動にうつせた、
dialogue.content: You were able to take action.

dialogue.origin: 怖かったんだ…ホントに‥
dialogue.content: I was scared... I really was...

dialogue.origin: ゆきさんには、次のステップに進む準備ができているんだよ！無意識で。
dialogue.content: Yuki, that means you're subconsciously ready to take the next step!

dialogue.origin: 人気者な彼さん、そんな彼が人気者でなくなっても好きかな？
dialogue.content: Your popular boyfriend... would you still love him if he weren't popular anymore?

dialogue.origin: (まってるね)
dialogue.content: (I'll wait.)

dialogue.origin: 人気者で、魅力がいっぱいだから、ゆきだけじゃなくて、みんなも好きなんだよね
dialogue.content: He's popular and has so much charm, so it's not just me; everyone likes him.

dialogue.origin: そういうのを、あえて4文字熟語でいうと、
dialogue.content: If I were to describe that with a four-character idiom,

dialogue.origin: 八方美人
dialogue.content: it would be "happo-bijin" (a people-pleaser).

dialogue.origin: て言うんだよ
dialogue.content: That's what it's called.

dialogue.origin: そうかも、そうかもしれないね…わかってても、今はどうすることもできない…
dialogue.content: Maybe... you might be right. But even if I know that, I can't do anything about it right now...

dialogue.origin: まだ、彼のそばにいたいと思う気持ちが勝っているのかな？
dialogue.content: Is the feeling of wanting to stay by his side still stronger?

dialogue.origin: うん。だけど、本当はもう、無理かなって、思ってる…
dialogue.content: Yes. But deep down, I think it's already hopeless...

dialogue.origin: そうだね、ゆきさんは無意識ではわかってるんだよね。だから怖い思いして携帯を覗いたんだもの。
dialogue.content: That's right. Subconsciously, you already know, don't you? That's why you went through all that fear and looked at his phone.

dialogue.origin: 「みんなに優しい人」「ゆきさんにだけ優しい人」どっちが幸せになれるかな？
dialogue.content: "Someone who is kind to everyone," or "someone who is kind only to you." Which one do you think would make you happier?

dialogue.origin: どっちも、彼らしいと思うけど、本当は、ゆきにだけ優しくしてくれる方が、安心できたと思う。
dialogue.content: I think both sound like him, but honestly, I think I would have felt more secure if he were only kind to me.

dialogue.origin: やきもち焼く自分になりたくなかったのかも…
dialogue.content: Maybe I just didn't want to be the jealous type...

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね！やきもちやいてる自分が嫌だったんだね！！
dialogue.content: I see! So you didn't like the jealous version of yourself!

dialogue.origin: ごめんね、気づいてあげられなくて。。
dialogue.content: I'm sorry I didn't realize that sooner.

dialogue.origin: ゆきも、今気づきました
dialogue.content: I just realized it now, too.

dialogue.origin: もひとつごめん、人気者で、浮気も確定した彼を持つと、誰でもやきもち焼くと思うよ！
dialogue.content: And one more thing, I'm sorry, but I think anyone would be jealous if they had a popular boyfriend who was confirmed to be cheating!

dialogue.origin: 時間押してしまって申し訳ないのだけれども、ゆきさんは、自分に自信がないのかな？
dialogue.content: I'm sorry for going over time, but Yuki, do you think you might lack self-confidence?

dialogue.origin: 理想の自分が、彼だったのかも。だから、「好き」って思ったんだね？
dialogue.content: Perhaps he embodied your ideal self. Is that why you thought you "liked" him?

dialogue.origin: いつも彼のおかげで、強く居られたけど、今は自信がなくなってるかも…
dialogue.content: I was always able to be strong thanks to him, but now I think I might be losing my confidence...

dialogue.origin: そっかそっか。じゃ、彼がいなくても誇れる自分になる方法があるんだ。
dialogue.content: I see, I see. Well then, there's a way for you to become someone you can be proud of, even without him.
What!?

dialogue.origin: どんな？
dialogue.content: How?

dialogue.origin: 毎日、何回も自分を褒めてあげるの！
dialogue.content: Every day, you praise yourself, many times!

dialogue.origin: 「今日もごはんがおいしい、ゆきえらい」
dialogue.content: "Today's meal was delicious. Good job, Yuki."

dialogue.origin: 「今日も寝坊しなかった、ゆきえらい」
dialogue.content: "I didn't oversleep today. Good job, Yuki."

dialogue.origin: 「今日もかわいい、ゆきえらい」
dialogue.content: "I'm cute today, too. Good job, Yuki."

dialogue.origin: こんな感じでいっぱい自分のことほめてあげて！
dialogue.content: Praise yourself a lot, just like that!

dialogue.origin: どんなことでも、えらくなっちゃうね
dialogue.content: So I can get a "good job" for anything, huh.

dialogue.origin: そうよ！だって、えらいんだもの！！気づかなかっただけ！そのうちだんだんゆきさんの魅力に気づいてきて、ゆきさん自分が好きになれるよ！
dialogue.content: That's right! Because you ARE great, you just didn't notice! Eventually, you'll start to notice your own charm, and you'll be able to like yourself, Yuki!

dialogue.origin: できそう？
dialogue.content: Do you think you can do it?

dialogue.origin: そうだといい
dialogue.content: I hope so.

dialogue.origin: やってみれそう？
dialogue.content: Do you feel like you can give it a try?

dialogue.origin: 好きになりたい。
dialogue.content: I want to like myself.

dialogue.origin: だから、やってみます
dialogue.content: So, I'll try.

dialogue.origin: 素晴らしい！がんばってみようね！
dialogue.content: Wonderful! Let's give it our best shot!

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 気づけなかった自分の魅力、気づいてあげないと、ゆきさんがかわいそうだものね！
dialogue.content: After all, it would be a shame if you didn't notice all the charm you have that you've been missing!

dialogue.origin: では、時間押してしまい、すみませんでした。また、魅力がわからなくなったら入ってきてね！
dialogue.content: Well then, I'm sorry for going over time. If you ever start to lose sight of your charm again, please come back!

dialogue.origin: いろいろありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you for everything.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you as well.

dialogue.origin: (時間おしてしまいすみませんでした。。今日はほんとにありがとうございました)
dialogue.content: (Sorry for going over time... Thank you so much for today.)

dialogue.origin: （大変勉強になりました、ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.content: (This was a great learning experience, thank you.)

dialogue.origin: （おつかれさまです！
dialogue.content: (Great work!)

dialogue.origin: (ではまたお会いできる日まで、お互いがんばりましょう！失礼します)
dialogue.content: (Well then, until we meet again, let's both do our best! Take care.)

topic.sub: 彼の浮気と信頼の問題
